top5.title: Multiplexed single-cell reduced representation bisulfite sequencing for genome-wide DNA methylation profiling
top5.why: Msc-RRBS enables parallel single-cell DNA methylation profiling of hundreds of cells in six days, resolving cell-to-cell methylation heterogeneity previously obscured by bulk methods.

top5.title: Strategies to develop therapeutic cancer vaccines for pancreatic cancer
top5.why: Personalized mRNA neoantigen vaccines induce durable CD8+ T-cell responses in postoperative pancreatic cancer, whereas conventional immunotherapies have consistently failed to provide clinical benefit.

top5.title: Emerging frontiers for AI in single-cell genomics
top5.why: Foundation models pretrained on large scRNA-seq atlases enable interpretation of new datasets within existing data resources, while emerging opportunities exist in epigenetic/multiomic assays and Perturb-seq for AI modeling.

top5.title: Multidimensional view of immunotherapy
top5.why: Primary research in a leading specialist journal. Topics: immunotherapy.

top5.title: Mechanisms of transcription control by distal enhancers from single-gene nanoscopy
top5.why: Cohesin-mediated loop extrusion actively brings enhancers and promoters within ≲100 nm to trigger transcriptional bursts through GTF cluster formation at enhancers.

also.title: Oncolytic virus VT1092M synergizes with immune checkpoint inhibitors against intraperitoneal metastases of colorectal cancer
also.why: Intraperitoneal VT1092M combined with anti-CTLA-4 antibody eliminates both peritoneal and systemic colorectal tumors through CD8+ T cell and M1 macrophage activation.

also.title: Aberrant Transcription-Factor Expression and Regulatory microRNAs in Metastatic Breast Cancer
also.why: TF-miRNA regulatory circuits control metastatic progression through epithelial-mesenchymal plasticity and treatment resistance, but circulating and tissue miRNA signals are not interchangeable biomarkers.

also.title: From Primary Cells to Organoids: Expanding the Biological Relevance of In Vitro Cellular Models
also.why: Review in a leading general journal. Topics: organoid, primary cell.

also.title: Lacrimal Secretory Niche Remodeling in Dry Eye Disease: Single-Cell and Spatial Insights into Acinar Dysfunction
also.why: Single-cell and spatial analyses reveal that lacrimal acinar secretory dysfunction in dry eye involves reversible functional suppression, niche remodeling, and structural failure as distinct mechanistic constraints requiring level-specific functional testing for validation.

also.title: Hypoxia-ROS-HSP Triad Axis in Cancer: Mechanisms, Crosstalk, and Therapeutic Implications
also.why: Hypoxia, ROS, and HSPs form mechanistically interconnected pathways that collectively drive tumor progression, positioning their coordinated targeting as a potential strategy to overcome therapeutic resistance.

also.title: Programmable bacterial vaccine vectors: A Design-Build-Control framework for precision immune engineering
also.why: A Design-Build-Control framework systematizes bacterial vector engineering through rational design principles, genetic stability strategies, and dynamic host-regulation tools rather than empirical attenuation alone.
